areas: Auburn, Sacramento, the Sierra Foothills, Truckee, and Lake Tahoe

hero.h1: Lighting Control Installation in Downtown Historic Auburn
hero.sub: Custom keypads, lighting scenes, voice control, and light that shifts with the day. Designed and installed by one team.

items.p: One button sets the whole room: Entertain, Dine, Evening, All Off. Each keypad is laid out for how you live.
Say the scene and the room follows. Every light, and the shades with it, from your voice, a keypad, or the app.
Cool, bright light in the morning. Warm and soft by evening. The whole house shifts on its own.

about.p: In 1981 our family home was robbed, and Liberty Bell Smart Home exists so no one else has to feel that. We believe every home should have the peace of mind, comfort, and beauty a smart system brings, designed by our ALA-certified lighting designers and installed with our sister company, Alpine Electric.
about.alt: The Liberty Bell Smart Home team outside the office

steps.p: We walk the plans with you and the homeowner: how each room is used, where the light falls, and what every keypad should do.
Ambient, task, and accent light layered on paper, with every fixture specified for the ceilings and finishes.
Loads and keypad locations handed over before drywall. With Alpine Electric it is one crew, not two.
Fixtures set, keypads programmed, scenes tuned in the room, then adjusted once the family has lived with them.

items.p: I recently moved into a home that had Liberty Bell and decided to give them a try. What a great decision!

We have used Liberty Bell in our home for 32 years. Service and equipment have been exceptionally reliable. We recently upgraded the system. Again, service was great. Will in the office and Ryan, the installing technician, were very courteous, timely, knowledgeable, and professional.

A room built for the picture and the sound.
